preconditions.description: The number of votes must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(vote) <= 26 for vote in votes)
preconditions.description: Each vote must contain between 1 and 26 unique team letters.

preconditions.expression: all(len(votes[i]) == len(votes[0]) for i in range(len(votes)))
preconditions.description: All votes must have the same length.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c.isupper() for c in vote) for vote in votes)
preconditions.description: All characters in the votes must be uppercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: all(set(votes[i]) == set(votes[0]) for i in range(len(votes)))
preconditions.description: All votes must contain the same set of team letters.

postconditions.description: The output string must be the teams sorted by the ranking system.
